title: Figure 19: Wide-angle plasmonic absorber based on negative index metamaterial
description: Left panel plots absorption versus incidence angle θ (0-40 degrees) for three cases with legend entries "PIMNIM", "Lx=∞, ε=μ=-1+i" and "L=200nm, ε=μ=-1+i", with an inset 3D unit-cell rendering. Right panel is a schematic of the absorption measurement showing incident H and E fields at angle θ onto a hatched "Metamaterial Absorber" slab of thickness Lx. Caption: "Figure 19. Wide-Angle Plasmonic Absorber Based on Negative Index Metamaterial."
